name: resumerag
description: Interview prep grounded in your own documents: a local-first RAG app with hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, citations and refusals, running in the browser with open-source models. Next.js + Transformers.js.

paragraphs: Interview prep, grounded in your own documents.

Upload your resume, project reports, notes and job descriptions. ResumeRAG builds a private knowledge base in your browser and helps you prepare for interviews with answers you can trace back to the exact passage. Retrieval and generation run on your own device with open-weight models: no API key, no account, no paid services.
Live demo → resumerag-gold.vercel.app · Project overview · Design decisions
features: Grounded or silent. Every answer cites numbered passages. If retrieval finds no relevant evidence, the model is not called at all — the app says "I couldn't find enough evidence in your uploaded documents to answer this…

Private by default. Parsing, chunking, embeddings, vector search, reranking and — by default — answer generation all run in Web Workers in your browser. Documents and vectors live in IndexedDB on your device. Unless you…
Explainable. Every answer has a "How this answer was generated" panel, and an evaluation suite measures each pipeline stage.
